# Gcore Public DNS

> Gcore Public DNS is a free recursive resolver with IPv4 and IPv6 addresses supporting plain DNS, DoH, and DoT queries.

- [Public DNS](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/public-dns.md): Gcore Public DNS is a free recursive resolver with IPv4 and IPv6 addresses supporting plain DNS, DoH, and DoT queries.
- [Configure a DNS resolver](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/configure-plain-dns.md): Set up a plain DNS resolver with Gcore Public DNS addresses on Windows and macOS network settings.
- [Configure DNS over HTTPS and DNS over TLS](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/configure-doh-and-dot.md): Set up DNS over HTTPS and DNS over TLS with Gcore Public DNS using the DoH URL and DoT hostname gcoredns.com.
- [Troubleshoot Gcore Public DNS](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/troubleshoot-public-dns.md): Fix Gcore Public DNS issues caused by DHCP, VPN, browser DoH, blocked encrypted DNS ports, and Windows DoH provider registration.
